in_marathi.name: Dharmraj
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Ruler of Dharma
in_marathi.long_meaning: Dharmraj हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Dharmraj is a Sanskrit name meaning 'Ruler of Dharma'. Dharma refers to moral principles, laws, and duties that guide an individual's actions and behavior. In Hindu mythology, Dharmraj is associated with the deity Dharma, the god of righteousness and justice, who upholds these moral principles and maintains cosmic order.
